findings.description:
DSCEngine.depositCollateral(address,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#315-332) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- received == 0 (src/DSCEngine.sol#328)

Reentrancy in DSCEngine.liquidate(address,address,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#277-302):
	External calls:
	- _redeemCollateral(collateral,collateralSeized,user,msg.sender) (src/DSCEngine.sol#294)
		- success = IERC20(token).transfer(to,amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#341)
	- _burnDsc(actualDebtCovered,user,msg.sender) (src/DSCEngine.sol#295)
		- success = i_dsc.transferFrom(dscFrom,address(this),amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#348)
		- i_dsc.burn(amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#350)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _burnDsc(actualDebtCovered,user,msg.sender) (src/DSCEngine.sol#295)
		- s_DSCMinted[onBehalfOf] -= amount (src/DSCEngine.sol#346)
	DSCEngine.s_DSCMinted (src/DSCEngine.sol#70) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DSCEngine._getAccountInformation(address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#395-402)
	- DSCEngine._healthFactor(address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#404-408)
	- DSCEngine.mintDsc(uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#304-312)
	- _settleLiquidation(user,startingHealthFactor,selectedCollateralExhausted) (src/DSCEngine.sol#298)
		- s_DSCMinted[user] = 0 (src/DSCEngine.sol#382)
	DSCEngine.s_DSCMinted (src/DSCEngine.sol#70) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DSCEngine._getAccountInformation(address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#395-402)
	- DSCEngine._healthFactor(address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#404-408)
	- DSCEngine.mintDsc(uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#304-312)
	- _settleLiquidation(user,startingHealthFactor,selectedCollateralExhausted) (src/DSCEngine.sol#298)
		- s_totalActiveDebt -= remainingDebt (src/DSCEngine.sol#383)
	DSCEngine.s_totalActiveDebt (src/DSCEngine.sol#62) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DSCEngine.getTotalAccountedDebt() (src/DSCEngine.sol#579-581)
	- DSCEngine.getTotalActiveDebt() (src/DSCEngine.sol#575-577)
	- DSCEngine.mintDsc(uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#304-312)

DSCEngine.setGuardian(address).newGuardian (src/DSCEngine.sol#143) lacks a zero-check on :
		- s_guardian = newGuardian (src/DSCEngine.sol#145)
DSCEngine.constructor(address[],address[],address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#108-137) has external calls inside a loop: tokenDecimals = IERC20Metadata(token).decimals() (src/DSCEngine.sol#120)
DSCEngine.constructor(address[],address[],address) (src/DSCEngine.sol#108-137) has external calls inside a loop: feedDecimals = AggregatorV3Interface(feed).decimals() (src/DSCEngine.sol#121)

Reentrancy in DSCEngine.liquidate(address,address,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#277-302):
	External calls:
	- _redeemCollateral(collateral,collateralSeized,user,msg.sender) (src/DSCEngine.sol#294)
		- success = IERC20(token).transfer(to,amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#341)
	- _burnDsc(actualDebtCovered,user,msg.sender) (src/DSCEngine.sol#295)
		- success = i_dsc.transferFrom(dscFrom,address(this),amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#348)
		- i_dsc.burn(amount) (src/DSCEngine.sol#350)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _settleLiquidation(user,startingHealthFactor,selectedCollateralExhausted) (src/DSCEngine.sol#298)
		- s_badDebt += remainingDebt (src/DSCEngine.sol#384)

Reentrancy in DSCEngine.depositCollateral(address,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#315-332):
	External calls:
	- success = IERC20(tokenCollateralAddress).transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amountCollateral) (src/DSCEngine.sol#325)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- s_collateralDeposited[msg.sender][tokenCollateralAddress] += received (src/DSCEngine.sol#330)

Reentrancy in DSCEngine.depositCollateralAndMintDsc(address,uint256,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#220-229):
	External calls:
	- depositCollateral(tokenCollateralAddress,amountCollateral) (src/DSCEngine.sol#227)
		- success = IERC20(tokenCollateralAddress).transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amountCollateral) (src/DSCEngine.sol#325)
	- mintDsc(amountDscToMint) (src/DSCEngine.sol#228)
		- minted = i_dsc.mint(msg.sender,amountDscToMint) (src/DSCEngine.sol#309)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- DscMinted(msg.sender,amountDscToMint) (src/DSCEngine.sol#311)
		- mintDsc(amountDscToMint) (src/DSCEngine.sol#228)

DSCEngine.executeRiskParameters(uint256,uint256,uint256) (src/DSCEngine.sol#182-209) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < s_pendingRiskChangeEta (src/DSCEngine.sol#192)

OracleLib.staleCheckLatestRoundData(AggregatorV3Interface,uint256) (src/libraries/OracleLib.sol#16-38) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- updatedAt == 0 || updatedAt > block.timestamp || answeredInRound < roundId (src/libraries/OracleLib.sol#30)
	- block.timestamp - updatedAt > heartbeat (src/libraries/OracleLib.sol#33)

Version constraint 0.8.19 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
	- VerbatimInvalidDeduplication
	- FullInlinerNonExpressionSplitArgumentEvaluationOrder
	- MissingSideEffectsOnSelectorAccess.
It is used by:
	- 0.8.19 (src/DSCEngine.sol#2)
	- 0.8.19 (src/DecentralizedStableCoin.sol#2)
	- 0.8.19 (src/libraries/OracleLib.sol#2)
Variable DSCEngine.s_DSCMinted (src/DSCEngine.sol#70) is not in mixedCase
Loop condition i < s_collateralTokens.length (src/DSCEngine.sol#496) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
